parts.text: (c) A student is testing how different surfaces absorb radiant heat. The student puts two metal plates in holders and places them on either side of a radiant heater as shown in Fig. 6.2. One plate has a shiny metal side facing towards the heater and the other plate has a dull black side facing towards the heater. A metal disc is attached to each plate using wax. Fig. 6.2
